note: Tuesday check ✅ Quick question for future you: did you floss last night? If not, tonight's the night 🧵🦷 Water bottle up!

meals: Smoked salmon and cream cheese on a toasted whole grain bagel, cucumber slices, a glass of milk
Plain Greek yogurt with crushed pistachios
Japanese chicken katsu with shredded cabbage, rice and miso soup
Celery and carrot sticks with hummus, water
Thai tom kha gai (coconut chicken soup) with jasmine rice and a fried egg. A small bowl of coconut ice cream right after
days.tip: Floss before the night brush, not after. Flossing loosens the gunk, then brushing sweeps it away.

meals: Shakshuka (eggs baked in tomato and pepper sauce) with feta and warm pita, a glass of milk
Greek chicken souvlaki in pita with tzatziki and a crunchy cucumber-tomato salad
Hard-boiled egg and a handful of cashews, water
Japanese shabu-shabu with thin beef, tofu, napa cabbage and mushrooms, sesame dipping sauce and rice. A few pieces of watermelon right after
days.tip: Tomato sauce is a bit acidic, so after shakshuka, rinse with water and wait 30 minutes before brushing.

meals: Ham and cheese croissant with scrambled eggs, a glass of milk
Cucumber and bell pepper sticks with tzatziki
Tuna poke bowl with rice, edamame, cucumber, avocado and seaweed (light on the sweet sauce)
Plain Greek yogurt with crushed almonds, water
Mild Indian butter chicken with basmati rice, garlic naan and cucumber raita. A small piece of kulfi right after
days.tip: Raita and yogurt are secret tooth heroes: the calcium helps rebuild enamel after a meal.
